connector.name: ClickHouse by alyiox
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for ClickHouse metadata, parameterized queries, and plan analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-clickhousex. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alyiox account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: MCP_CLICKHOUSE_DSN
env.description: Optional shortcut DSN for the default profile, for example http://user:password@host:8123/database. For multiple profiles, use ~/.config/mcp-clickhousex/config.json or MCP_CLICKHOUSE_PROFILES_<NAME>_DSN.
